label: A verb saying what the program is doing, as the first word of a print/log status message in code (logger.info("Starting server"), printf("Initializing buffers\n"), System.out.println("Processing batch")); past-tense status ("Saved results", "Model loaded") and shell echo fire weaker; error, warning, greeting and count messages, the same verbs in comments, variable names or prose, and non-verb '-ing' words (Morning, Something) stay low, though any message after a run of print lines can fire weakly.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit
